description: Bruitages et musiques du monde Manoir Blackwood (dossier /71/ des cartes SD).

sons.prompt: Gothic pipe organ chord, distant thunder and a raven caw, Victorian haunted manor intro

sons.nom: Ambiance : le manoir dans la tempête
sons.prompt: Old Victorian manor at night during a storm, rain on windows, wind howling, creaking wood, ticking grandfather clock, seamless loop
Old brass padlock clicking open, then a wooden drawer sliding out
Loud close thunder clap, window bursting open, wind rushing in
Someone blowing dust off a stone plaque, soft whoosh, faint echo in a chapel
Slow creaking footsteps on old wooden floorboards in a corridor, stopping, then hurrying away
Heavy framed painting falling off a wall, wood frame hitting stone floor
Solemn but uplifting gothic organ and strings resolution, mystery solved
Single tolling funeral church bell, fading into wind
Ghostly whisper and cold ethereal whoosh, eerie choir breath
Grandfather clock chiming in an old manor hall
Single raven caw, close, slightly echoing
Old heavy wooden door creaking open slowly
